summary: Gommoni GEB module tested end-to-end. Backend: 29/29 pytest passed (CRUD modelli/accessori/preventivi, sconti validation, all 3 PDF endpoints incl. categoria validation, auto-numbering G2026-NNN, totale math). Frontend: Home cta-gommoni -> /gommoni works; sidebar nav-gommoni visible; catalogo CRUD (create/edit/delete gommone) OK; sconti dialog saves & persists (reopen shows saved value); import AI dialog opens; accessori CRUD OK; preventivo dialog: select gommone populates modello/prezzo, tipo cliente switches sconto, add accessorio adds row, motore Suzuki select populates motore field, totale computes, preview PDF and saved PDF open, preventivo saved and appears in table. Regression: /suzuki still loads with tab-modelli, /api/suzuki/modelli 200. One real backend bug found: PUT /api/gommoni/preventivi/{id} returns 500 when 'data' field is omitted from body (Optional[str]=None overwrites required str). Also flagged: PreventiviGommoniTab edit/delete buttons on preventivo rows are missing data-testid.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (Pydantic ValidationError: data is None) when request body omits 'data'. Root cause in routers/gommoni.py:444: payload.model_dump() includes data=None which overrides the persisted string. Fix: use payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True) or set default data if None.

ui_bugs.issue: Edit (Pencil) and Delete (Trash2) buttons on preventivo rows have no data-testid, unlike the PDF button. Requested test flow references btn-pdf-prev-gommone only, but consistency (btn-edit-prev-gommone-{id}, btn-del-prev-gommone-{id}) helps testing/regression.

issues: React dev-mode 'hydration' warning: <span> child inside <option> (from Emergent JSX source annotations). Harmless in prod build but pollutes console.

action_items: Fix PUT /api/gommoni/preventivi/{id}: use exclude_none or default 'data' when None to avoid 500 on partial updates.
(Optional) Add data-testid on Edit/Delete buttons in PreventiviGommoniTab rows for symmetry with PDF button.
(Optional) Auto-close ScontiDialog after save OR give clearer 'saved' feedback — current UX keeps dialog open with unchanged state.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/gommoni.py update_preventivo (line 444) and update_modello (line 61) merge payload.model_dump() without exclude_none; any Optional field left null in an update payload will overwrite valid persisted values. High risk of data loss/500.

gommoni.py _next_numero counts by 'data' regex ^{year}- but 'data' field format is date YYYY-MM-DD, so regex works. However count-based numbering is not race-safe (two concurrent creates get same numero); consider find one max numero.
gommoni.py _run_vision creates a new LlmChat per page even when session_id would be enough for one chat; costly for multi-page PDFs. Acceptable for MVP.
PreventivoGommoneDialog uses select without data-testid on some rows; motore select works via test-id only via custom Select wrapper.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed data (models, accessori, preventivi) created during tests were cleaned up via DELETE. The main-agent seeded 'GEB 620 Open', 'Tendalino' and G2026-001 were preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend PUT preventivo 500-on-missing-data-field is documented in test_gommoni.py as `test_update_without_data_field_returns_500_bug` (currently asserts status in {200,500}); after fix, tighten to ==200. Auth via {"password":"admin"} cookie session. Preventivo total math test asserts exact 38160.00.
rca of the issue: PUT /api/gommoni/preventivi/{id}: payload GommonePreventivoCreate has 'data: Optional[str] = None'. Handler merges {**doc, **payload.model_dump()} — the None value overrides doc['data']. Then GommonePreventivo requires data as str -> ValidationError -> 500. Repro: PUT with body missing 'data' key. Fix: use payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True) OR set data default in handler if None (`data = data or doc.get('data')`).
